title: CS2 event guide — Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals
intro: Source-linked CS2 event reference: the advertised venue and reservation, visible daily agenda, third-party bracket leads, teams, format and online broadcast. Read each source type and caveat. records.description: The venue for the Counter-Strike 2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals is now confirmed by the event's own ticketing page: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, at the MFCC South Gate National Stadium in Attard (ATD 4000). A fresh 11 October Eventbrite extraction visibly named Legacy, Falcons, FURIA, Betboom, 9z and Aurora in the lineup block, then a View all control. PARIVISION, NIP and Virtus.pro were not in that visible set, so the ticket page does not settle the replacement reports.

The eight-team field and Valve ranking positions come from the Thunderpick-issued 16 Sept 2026 release used as this record's primary source; that release still names Virtus.pro, so it is now partly superseded. The withdrawal and replacement are reported by third-party esports media and are not yet reflected on the organiser pages checked: HLTV, 9 Oct 2026 — https://www.hltv.org/news/45688/thunderpick-world-championship-matchups-announced-with-virtuspro-replaced-by-nip (also gives the opening matchups and the Group A / Group B split); Hotspawn — https://www.hotspawn.com/counter-strike/news/nip-replace-virtus-pro-at-thunderpick-world-championship-2026 ; Liquipedia's participant note records 'October 9th - Virtus.pro withdraw from the event due to health and visa issues; they are replaced by Ninjas in Pyjamas': https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . The press release is historical field evidence; the later NIP reporting supersedes its Virtus.pro slot. records.hours: Group A: Falcons, Ninjas in Pyjamas, 9z, Aurora. Group B: FURIA, BETBOOM, Legacy, PARIVISION. The 14 October openers are 9z v Aurora, Falcons v Ninjas in Pyjamas, Legacy v PARIVISION and FURIA v BETBOOM. Read directly on 11 October 2026 the same HLTV page displayed those four matches at 04:30, 07:00, 09:30 and 12:00; a search-index rendering of the identical table read the same day showed 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and 18:00 — exactly six hours later, the offset between EDT and Malta's CEST. On that evidence the Malta local start times are 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and 18:00, and the first of them matches the ticketing listing's own 14 October “games 10:30” row. These are match clocks, not door times.
records.price range: Not applicable — match schedule. Event-specific spectator admission price and current reservation path are unconfirmed; see the spectator ticketing record.
records.description: The tournament uses two best-of-three GSL groups that send four teams to a single-elimination playoff, ending with a third-place decider and a best-of-five grand final. Ninjas in Pyjamas replaced Virtus.pro on 9 October 2026 after a withdrawal caused by a visa problem and a player health issue; because it fell within 20 days of the event, the organiser's rulebook takes the replacement from the next eligible team in the host region, which is why a European side was called up. NIP were drawn into Group A against the top seed Falcons with 9z and Aurora; Group B pairs Legacy with PARIVISION and FURIA with BETBOOM. For planning purposes the useful fact is the shape of the day: four matches are spread from mid-morning to early evening on 14 October, the listing's own agenda starts games at 10:30 with 09:30 check-in, and the published end for Wednesday and Thursday is 22:30. Confirm match order, times and the actual gate with the organiser's live bracket before planning a departure.
records.notes: Groups, matchups, the GSL/single-elimination/Bo5 structure, the withdrawal reasons and the replacement rule come from HLTV's report of 9 October 2026 (article timestamp 13:07 in the page's own displayed zone), read directly on 11 October 2026: https://www.hltv.org/news/45688/thunderpick-world-championship-matchups-announced-with-virtuspro-replaced-by-nip . The page renders match clocks in the reader's zone and does not label them: the direct read showed 04:30 / 07:00 / 09:30 / 12:00 for the four 14 October openers, while a search-index rendering of the same table showed 10:30 / 13:00 / 15:30 / 18:00. The two renderings differ by exactly six hours, which is the EDT-to-CEST offset, and the later set is the Malta local reading; it is corroborated by the ticketing listing's own “games 10:30” row for 14 October (https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841). Malta is on CEST (UTC+2) for the whole trip window. The organiser's own page published no per-match running order when re-read the same day: https://world-championship.thunderpick.io/2026-finals/ . Liquipedia's bracket page remains the other third-party clock source and labels its sections in EDT: https://liquipedia.net/counterstrike/Thunderpick/World_Championship/2026 . Rosters, matchups and order can still change; no match time here is a door time, and none of it is evidence of a radio broadcast. Independent cross-check and one outlier, both found on 11 October 2026: the separate record `twc-match-times-malta` converts Liquipedia's own EDT labels (04:30, 07:00, 09:30 and 12:00) to the same four Malta times by adding six hours, which corroborates this record from a different source path. One row in the master source log, however, cites 18:30 CEST for the fourth opener; 12:00 EDT converts to 18:00 CEST and the bracket report's Malta-time reading also gives 18:00, so 18:00 is used here and the 18:30 entry is flagged as an outlier to recheck against the organiser's live bracket rather than silently reconciled. Liquipedia re-read 12 October 2026: the Upcoming Matches block now names all four opening pairings with clocks printed 04:30, 07:00, 09:30 and 12:00 EDT — 9z–Aurora, Falcons–NIP, Legacy–PARIVISION, FURIA–BetBoom — matching the Malta-time set 10:30, 13:00, 15:30 and 18:00 used here; the 17 October semifinal slot (10:00 EDT / 16:00 Malta) still shows TBD versus TBD.
